chunks: Al-Husayn b. Ahmad b. Idris (may Allah have mercy on him) narrated to us. He said: My father narrated to us. He said: Muhammad b. al-Husayn b. Abi al-Khattab narrated to us. He said: Uthman b. Isa narrated to me from al-Ala' b. al-Musayyib from Abi Abdillah Ja'far b. Muhammad from his father from his forefathers (upon them be peace). He said:

Al-Hasan b. Ali (peace be upon them both) said to the Messenger of Allah (may Allah bless him and his family): O father! What is the reward of one who visits you? So he said: Whoever visits me, or visits your father, or visits you, or visits your brother, it will be a right upon me to visit him on the Day of Resurrection so that I may redeem him from his sins.

key_terms.زيارة: visitation, pilgrimage to the shrines of holy figures

ai.seo_question: What is the reward for visiting the Prophet Muhammad and the Imams according to Shia hadith?
ai.summary: In this hadith, Imam al-Hasan (the second Imam) asks his grandfather the Prophet Muhammad about the reward for visiting him. The Prophet responds that whoever visits him, Ali (Imam al-Hasan's father), al-Hasan, or al-Husayn (his brother), the Prophet guarantees he will visit that person on the Day of Judgment and intercede to redeem them from their sins. This hadith establishes the spiritual merit of ziyara (visitation) of the Prophet and his household.
word_analysis: may Allah have mercy on him
